description: Returns the zodiac sign the Moon is in at a date and local time, in a time zone or city, with its degree in the sign and the next sign change. Without a time it returns every sign the Moon is in during that date. The tropical or the Lahiri sidereal zodiac can be chosen.

date.description: Local calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100, such as a birth date; the Moon right now when omitted.

place.description: A city from the website's list of 136 world cities, such as the birthplace; its time zone is used unless timeZone is given.

time.description: Local clock time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock, such as a birth time. Without it the result covers the whole date.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name of the date and time, such as the birthplace's zone; UTC when omitted.

zodiac.description: Zodiac origin: tropical (the March equinox) or lahiri (sidereal); tropical when omitted.

name: get_moon_sign
title: Moon sign
